scope: Fixed TRAIN-only FP32 eval-mode gradient evidence; no optimizer, updates, validation/test evaluation, checkpoint selection or gate amendment
sampling: Unmodified fixed_training_subset(records.train,64): fractions .5,0,1,.25 over sorted realizations, deduplicate, first64; preserve function order, consecutive pairs, no shuffle/augmentation
mode: model.eval(); all modules eval, parameters require gradients, FP32 forward/loss/gradients; autocast/TF32 disabled; no optimizer/scaler/clipping/steps

decoder.membership: all non-encoder parameters INCLUDING output head

output_head.membership: model.head; SUBSET of decoder, not an independent disjoint block

loss_reductions.mask: Same finite inclusive GT[.1,1000]m, prediction globally finite and >=.1; near GT<10m
loss_reductions.gradient: sum_valid_horizontal abs(deltaP-deltaG)/n_valid_horizontal + analogous vertical term, exactly existing loss
loss_reductions.near_MAE: sum_N abs(P-G)/|N|; differentiable zero when no N
loss_reductions.current_near_partition: L1 numerator restricted N but denominator |V|; log analog; gradient numerators restricted to valid edges with >=1 near-GT endpoint but denominators remain ALL valid edges of that direction. Boundary near/far edges belong to near-incident partition.
loss_reductions.current_far_partition: Complementary far-pixel L1/log and far-only valid gradient edges; original denominators. Sum with near partition reconstructs current objective.
loss_reductions.candidate: Existing current objective +0.2*separately normalized near_MAE; identical input tensors and single shared forward graph.

comparisons: per-block raw L2 and per-parameter RMS for components and weighted components
near-partition/current norm ratio and weighted .2*near_MAE/current norm ratio; these ratios are not additive percentage shares
Euclidean first-order near-descent dot products for current/candidate; not AdamW-preconditioned updates

validity_criteria.input_prediction_parity: One forward shared by all objectives; RGB/GT/mask/prediction hashes unchanged between reverse passes
validity_criteria.model_and_batchnorm: State digest identical initially, after every batch, and finally; no accumulated parameter .grad fields
validity_criteria.RNG: Python/NumPy/CPU/CUDA and loader-generator identity unchanged across each reverse pass and its common forward
validity_criteria.no_invalid_value_omission: Undefined cosine for zero vector is explicit null, not nonfinite data silently removed
validity_criteria.on_failure: Stop and report invalid/incomplete; no automatic change to sample, coefficient, mode, tolerance or device

repair_support_rule.origin: Numeric descriptive decision rules operationalized HERE before reading probe images/gradients; not claimed to be numerical thresholds from the older qualitative proposal. No statistical independence/significance claim.
repair_support_rule.head: supplementary; cannot alone trigger support
repair_support_rule.informative: near_count>0 and both current and near_MAE block norms>1e-12; all other batches retained and reported
repair_support_rule.conflict_signal: cos(current,near_MAE)<-0.05 in at least max(4,ceil(.25*n_informative)) batches; candidate cosine improves by >=.05 in >=75% of those conflicting batches
repair_support_rule.weak_signal: norm(current_near_partition)/norm(current)<=.10 in at least max(4,ceil(.50*n_informative)) batches; weighted .2*near_MAE norm/current norm >=.10 in >=75% of those weak batches
repair_support_rule.breadth: Triggering batches together cover >=4 underlying path groups and >=2 sampling fraction passes, and contain >=1 foggy TRAIN record. Mixed batches do not identify a trajectory-specific gradient cause.
repair_support_rule.support: All validity criteria pass and either conflict or weak signal plus breadth holds for encoder or decoder. Supports REVIEW of exactly one pilot, not measured improvement, gate acceptance or KD.
repair_support_rule.otherwise: No teacher-repair training justified by this probe; report negative/inconclusive evidence without new thresholds.

conditional_pilot_if_supported.status: Proposal only; never launched in this task
conditional_pilot_if_supported.single_intervention: teacher near_weight 0 -> .2 using existing GT<10m separately normalized MAE, no other loss changes
conditional_pilot_if_supported.data: full frozen TRAIN and unchanged VAL, no new data or resplit
conditional_pilot_if_supported.initialization: Fresh exact ImageNet1K_V2 encoder cache and decoder seed, not rejected teacher checkpoint fine-tuning; historical teacher first-five-epoch control if exact parity established, otherwise fresh matched near_weight0 control needed
conditional_pilot_if_supported.BN: original train-mode BN batch2 during training, unchanged eval-mode FP32 selection
conditional_pilot_if_supported.selection: minimum pooled FP32 validation AbsRel, no alternate checkpoint promotion
conditional_pilot_if_supported.success: Selected pilot checkpoint passes unchanged original numerical gate vs selected A: strictly lower pooled AbsRel, every path overall/near AbsRel/RMSE <=A, exact counts; finite training and all preregistered budget identities. Failure stops; no coefficient search. Pilot does not authorize full KD or silently become full scope.
conditional_pilot_if_supported.historical_cost: 8.98h for original B first5, 40.48h full20; new USB/runtime unknown. Fresh matched control roughly doubles pilot cost.
conditional_pilot_if_supported.implementation_constraint: Current trainer rejects changed near weight and mixed source identities. Needs separately reviewed pilot/config/source lineage; no weakening existing guards or altering failed gate.
